workarounds.note: renderToPdf asks for the bold and italic of every family, set or not: FONTS lists every one Crimson Text and Fraunces can be asked for, and the provider answers Tenor Sans's missing styles with its one face and logs each stand-in
every frontmatter value is quoted: the cover prints {author} and {subtitle}, and the PDF takes its title and author from them
level 1's breakBefore (parity 'any') is restated because a headings object drops it
the performers' heading style sets breakBefore: { enabled: false }, or it would inherit level 1's page break
col() writes the hex beside each paletteId: 1.4.1 paints the cover, opener and footer elements from the hex (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
the design titles take lineHeight as a multiple (1, 0.95, 1.25), never a Dimension
